notes: A marker for SI11: one of Wales' largest public organisations has a refreshed plan, but rising supply chain emissions show the limits of estate-only action.
summary: On 7 November 2025, during Wales Climate Week, the Welsh Government published a refreshed NHS Wales Decarbonisation Strategic Delivery Plan setting a route to the 2050 net zero target. NHS organisations cut emissions from non supply chain sources such as buildings and transport by almost a quarter between 2018-19 and 2024, but overall NHS Wales emissions rose over the same period because of its large supply chain.
title: Refreshed NHS Wales Decarbonisation Strategic Delivery Plan published; supply chain emissions still rising
